Seared Scallops with Lemon Butter Sauce

Ingredients

  • 1 pound large sea scallops, patted dry
  • 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 4 tablespoons unsalted butter
  • 2 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1/4 cup dry white wine
  • 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice
  • 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
  • Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

Instructions

Step 1: Prepare Scallops

Pat the scallops very dry with paper towels. Season both sides with salt and pepper.

Step 2: Sear Scallops

Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, add scallops in a single layer (do not overcrowd). Sear for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through.

Step 3: Make Lemon Butter Sauce

Remove scallops from skillet and set aside. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let it melt. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Pour in white wine and lemon juice, bring to a simmer, and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly reduced.

Step 4: Combine and Serve

Return scallops to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce. Stir in fresh parsley. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

Filet Mignon with Red Wine Reduction

Ingredients

  • 2 (6-8 ounce) filet mignon steaks, about 1.5 inches thick
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, divided
  • 1 shallot, finely chopped
  • 1 cup dry red wine
  • 1 cup beef broth
  • 1 sprig fresh thyme
  • Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

Instructions

Step 1: Prepare Filet Mignon

Pat the filet mignon steaks dry with paper towels. Season generously with salt and pepper.

Step 2: Sear Filet Mignon

Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 2 tablespoons of butter. Once butter is melted and skillet is hot, sear filet mignon for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, or longer for desired doneness. Remove steaks and set aside to rest.

Step 3: Make Red Wine Reduction

Reduce heat to medium. Add shallot to the skillet and cook until softened, about 2-3 minutes. Pour in red wine and thyme sprig, bring to a simmer, and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Cook until wine is reduced by half.

Step 4: Finish Sauce and Serve

Add beef broth to the skillet and continue to simmer until sauce is thickened and reduced to about 1 cup. Remove thyme sprig. Whisk in remaining 2 tablespoons of butter until sauce is glossy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Spoon red wine reduction over filet mignon and serve.

Lobster Risotto with Saffron

Ingredients

  • 6 cups fish stock
  • 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads
  • 4 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 small onion, finely chopped
  • 1.5 cups Arborio rice
  • 1/2 cup dry white wine
  • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese, plus more for serving
  • 4 tablespoons unsalted butter
  • 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
  • Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

Instructions

Step 1: Prepare Lobster and Stock

Humanely dispatch lobsters. Remove lobster meat from tails and claws, roughly chop. In a saucepan, heat fish stock and saffron threads, keep warm over low heat.

Step 2: Sauté Onion and Rice

In a large, heavy-bottomed pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes. Add Arborio rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes until grains are translucent around the edges.

Step 3: Deglaze and Cook Risotto
